text:
Alex: Quick thread — Bridgeport LLM Salon next week. Need final plan for booth drop, swag counts, and speaker folx. Who can own pickups?
Taylor: I can pick up swag Wednesday morning. How many tees vs stickers vs postcards?
Alex: Current order from vendor: 60 tees (S-XL), 500 stickers, 300 postcards, 120 stickers - wait double counted. Let me pull the PO. :grimacing:
Alex: Correct numbers: 60 tees, 500 stickers, 300 postcards, 150 enamel pins.
Taylor: Cool. I’ll bring a hand truck and lockbox. ETA on table banners?
Jamal: Banner is in the office storage bay B3. I can grab it with the AV gear. We’ll need 2 power strips and gaffer tape.
Maria: Speaker submission status: 3 confirmed talks, 2 pending. I posted the approval notes in the doc: https://doc.company/bridgeport-speakers
Olivia: Lead capture: I suggest QR form + two iPads. Route leads via our shared inbox -> SF sales queue if >500 ARR, else SDR queue.
Olivia: Routing rule: include `utm=bridgeport` so we can filter in Gainsight. Also add checkbox "interested in dedicated".
Alex: Nice. Can someone make the QR page? Simple form with name, email, company, ARR bracket, interest. Short and sweet.
Taylor: I can make the QR landing tonight. Will reuse the template from last week and swap copy.
EventBot: Reminder: Parking permit deadline in 48h. https://events.company/permits (auto-reminder)
Jamal: AV note: onsite WiFi is flaky. We'll bring a 5G hotspot and cable for one laptop. Anyone needs HDMI adapter?
Maria: I need a dongle for MacBook Air — can borrow?
Alex: Jamal will bring adapters, + extra USB-C.
Taylor: Swag packing plan: 10 tees per box (label size on outside), 50 stickers per envelope for the demo table, pins in small vial. Will pack and stage in marketing closet by 5pm Thursday.
Olivia: For lead handoff, I'll make two Slack channels: #bridgeport-leads-sales and #bridgeport-leads-sdr. Use `/handoff <leadid>` to post.
Alex: Good. Can we do a 30-min dry run Friday morning at 9:30? Quick deploy + flow test.
Maria: I'm in. Will rehearse intro for booth talks (2x 7-min lightning demos).
Taylor: Also need consent language on iPad: "By submitting you agree to be contacted" short copy ready.
Alex: Final ask: Who can be onsite contact for returns/inventory after the event?
Taylor: I'll own returns and drop at warehouse Sunday evening.
Olivia: I'll export leads and upload CRM Monday morning and tag source=bridgeport.
Jamal: Packing list copied: Banners, table throws, 2x iPads, charger kit, hotspot, 2 power strips, gaffer, hand truck, boxes of swag, dongles. I'll attach as checklist in the doc.
Alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone — last-minute checklist Friday. :thumbsup:
